Privacy Policy

PawTale works without an account. Pet profiles, records, and the photos you select are stored on your device by default.

On-device storage

Pet profiles, care and health records, schedules, albums, supplies, expenses, canvas projects, and preferences are saved on your device. Pet profiles can include emergency contacts, clinic names, or phone numbers you choose to enter. The current version has no PawTale account or developer-operated server that receives these records.

Photos and photo library access

When you add a photo to a profile, record, album, or canvas, PawTale uses the iOS photo picker. The app can access the photos you select and keeps a copy when needed. Saving a canvas export to Photos may require permission to add photos only. You can manage access in iOS Settings.

Notifications

Your device schedules notifications locally for tasks, medication, supplies, and anniversaries. You can turn off notifications or change how they appear in iOS Settings. Your schedule is still available in PawTale.

Backups, sharing, and deletion

In Settings → Data & Backup, you can export a care data backup and choose where to save it or whom to share it with. The backup may contain photos, health notes, and contact information. If you save it to iCloud Drive or use an iOS device backup, those copies are managed by the service and settings you choose.

You can edit or delete records in the app. Deleting PawTale removes the data in its on-device container. Copies you save in Photos, Files, or a backup service, or share with someone else, are managed separately.

Potential iCloud sync

In-app iCloud sync is currently unavailable. We are exploring sync between devices using the same Apple Account, with care records and related photos stored in Apple’s private CloudKit database. If sync becomes available, we will update this policy with what it covers and how to enable it, stop it, and manage cloud copies.

Website visits and support email

GitHub Pages hosts this site. GitHub may log visitors’ IP addresses for security purposes. This site has no third-party analytics, advertising, or feedback form. If you email us, we use your email address, message, and any attachments to respond and resolve your request. Contact us to ask about or request deletion of materials you sent to support.
